newsitem.title: FINLAND: Six-month Finnish paper export price fall ends Oct.
newsitem.headline: Six-month Finnish paper export price fall ends Oct.

text.p: A six-month straight fall in pulp, paper and paper product export prices came to a halt in October, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Monday.

Export prices in the pulp, paper and paper products category showed a flat month-on-month change in October -- the first reading not in the red since March, SF said. But year-on-year, pulp and paper export prices fell 10.4 percent.

Export prices of wood and wood products rose 3.8 percent in October from September, SF said, adding that this, together with higher petroleum products export prices, pushed the export price index to its first month-on-month rise since March.
On a year-on-year basis, the export price index fell 3.7 percent -- mainly due to cheaper pulp, paper, paperboard and base metals export prices, SF said.
In October, export prices of base metals fell 1.0 percent month-on-month for a 16.7 percent fall year-on-year.
Export prices of machinery and equipment were unchanged in October compared to September and rose 3.9 percent year-on-year.
Export prices of electrotechnical products and optical equipment fell 0.1 percent month-on-month and fell 0.4 percent year-on-year.
